title: China-to-Sri-Lanka Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Power tools placed on the Sri Lanka market are assessed for electrical safety against SLS standards that adopt the IEC 62841 series, administered through SLSI national certification and import inspection. Mains-corded tools, chargers, and external power supplies must suit a 230 V 50 Hz supply; the charger or adapter of a cordless tool is assessed as a separate electrical item alongside the tool body.
target_standards: SLS standards adopting the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and garden electric tools
SLSI national certification and import-inspection scheme （Sri Lanka Standards Institution）
230 V 50 Hz supply design for mains tools, chargers, and external power supplies
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools and separate charger standards where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence and any CCC documentation should be mapped to the SLS/IEC 62841 requirements verified by SLSI rather than treated as automatic Sri Lanka acceptance.
china_standards: CCC where applicable for the China domestic market
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: Two common gaps appear. First, voltage: many China files validate the tool for a 220 V 380 V environment, while Sri Lanka uses 230 V single phase, so supply ratings and charger input must be confirmed for 230 V. Second, documentation: GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence is not an SLSI grant, so a separate SLSI certification and import-inspection step is needed with the SLS mark where the scheme requires it.

target.en: Mandatory in practice for in-scope tools: SLSI national certification and import inspection against adopted SLS/IEC 62841 electrical-safety standards, with the SLS mark where the scheme requires it. The underlying IEC 62841 test standards are the technical route used inside that mandatory conformity scheme.
target.zh: 对适用工具实务上为强制：按采用的 SLS/IEC 62841 电气安全标准完成 SLSI 国家认证和进口检验，并在制度要求时加贴 SLS 标志。底层 IEC 62841 测试标准是该强制符合性制度内使用的技术路径。
target.zht: 對適用工具實務上為強制：按採用的 SLS/IEC 62841 電氣安全標準完成 SLSI 國家認證和進口檢驗，並在制度要求時加貼 SLS 標誌。底層 IEC 62841 測試標準是該強制符合性制度內使用的技術路徑。

cn.en: China domestic evidence commonly uses GB/T 3883 series and charger-specific standards, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内证据通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列及充电器专项标准，并在适用时采用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內證據通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列及充電器專項標準，並在適用時採用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Sri-Lanka-ready until the tool body and any charger or external power supply are confirmed for 230 V 50 Hz and the file is taken through SLSI certification and import inspection against adopted SLS/IEC 62841 standards. GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence supports but does not replace the SLSI grant.

rows.target_requirement: Motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies must not generate excessive electromagnetic disturbance and must have adequate immunity. Sri Lanka relies on SLS standards that adopt the relevant IEC EMC standards （CISPR and IEC 61000 families）, applied within SLSI conformity and, for the radio module of cordless tools, alongside TRCSL type approval.
target_standards: SLS standards adopting IEC EMC standards （CISPR and IEC 61000 families）
SLSI conformity scheme for in-scope electrical apparatus
TRCSL type approval for the radio module of cordless tools （emission aspects）
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, inclusion of the charger, and whether the report maps to the IEC-based limits SLSI accepts still need destination-specific review.
china_standards: China EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is an EMC report that tests only the bare tool but omits the charger, battery pack, electronic controller variants, or worst-case load conditions, or that cites China national EMC limits without confirming the IEC-based limits SLSI accepts. The dossier should show the exact marketed configuration and justify representative-model coverage.

target.en: Applied within the SLSI conformity scheme for in-scope apparatus using IEC-based EMC limits; for cordless tools the radio-emission aspect is also addressed through TRCSL type approval. The exact mandatory scope depends on the tool category and SLSI control list at the time of import.
target.zh: 在 SLSI 符合性制度内对适用设备使用基于 IEC 的 EMC 限值；对无绳工具，无线电发射方面还通过 TRCSL 型号核准处理。确切强制范围取决于进口时的工具类别和 SLSI 管控目录。
target.zht: 在 SLSI 符合性制度內對適用設備使用基於 IEC 的 EMC 限值；對無繩工具，無線電發射方面還透過 TRCSL 型號核准處理。確切強制範圍取決於進口時的工具類別和 SLSI 管控目錄。

cn.en: China domestic files may include EMC evidence, but acceptance in Sri Lanka depends on scope, limits, configuration, and mapping to the IEC-based standards SLSI applies.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 EMC 证据，但斯里兰卡的接受性取决于范围、限值、配置，以及对 SLSI 适用的基于 IEC 标准的映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 EMC 證據，但斯里蘭卡的接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置，以及對 SLSI 適用的基於 IEC 標準的映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Sri-Lanka-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system, maps to the IEC-based limits SLSI accepts, and for cordless tools is consistent with TRCSL radio type approval.

rows.requirement: Market Access Under SLSI Certification and SLS Marking
rows.target_requirement: Market access for electric and cordless power tools in Sri Lanka runs through the Sri Lanka Standards Institution （SLSI）, which operates mandatory product certification and import inspection and grants the SLS mark for products meeting adopted SLS standards. SLS standards commonly adopt IEC and EN texts, including the IEC 62841 series for power-tool safety. Goods typically enter through the Port of Colombo and may face import inspection at clearance.
target_standards: SLSI mandatory product certification and import-inspection scheme （Sri Lanka Standards Institution）
SLS mark for products conforming to adopted SLS standards
SLS standards adopting the IEC 62841 series for power-tool safety
Port of Colombo import clearance and inspection
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, transportable tools, and garden machinery, with CCC for the China domestic market where applicable. This evidence does not by itself produce an SLSI grant, the SLS mark, or Sri Lanka import clearance.
china_standards: CCC where applicable for the China domestic market
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Sri Lanka placement. The importer needs SLSI certification or import-inspection clearance against the adopted SLS/IEC 62841 standards, the SLS mark where required, and a dossier mapped to Sri Lanka rather than to China national or EU frameworks. Import documentation and inspection at the Port of Colombo should be planned before shipment.

target.en: Mandatory in practice: SLSI product certification and import inspection for in-scope power tools, with the SLS mark where the scheme requires it. The adopted IEC 62841 standards are the technical basis used inside that mandatory scheme.
target.zh: 实务上为强制：对适用电动工具进行 SLSI 产品认证和进口检验，并在制度要求时加贴 SLS 标志。采用的 IEC 62841 标准是该强制制度内使用的技术基础。
target.zht: 實務上為強制：對適用電動工具進行 SLSI 產品認證和進口檢驗，並在制度要求時加貼 SLS 標誌。採用的 IEC 62841 標準是該強制制度內使用的技術基礎。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses the GB/T 3883 series, with CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，并在适用时采用 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，並在適用時採用 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Sri-Lanka-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 or CCC evidence. SLSI certification or import-inspection clearance against adopted SLS/IEC 62841 standards and the SLS mark where required are needed; China evidence can support but cannot replace the SLSI grant.

rows.target_requirement: Sri Lanka does not operate an EU-style product-marking regime equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC, so there is no separate guaranteed-sound-power marking obligation on the power tool itself for placing it on the market. Noise is instead handled through the occupational health and safety framework administered by the Department of Labour （workplace exposure control） and through general environmental and nuisance rules, plus any noise-related test data captured inside the SLS/IEC 62841 safety assessment. Exporters should not assume an EU outdoor-noise marking is required, and equally should not assume noise is unregulated.
target_standards: No Sri Lanka equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking
Department of Labour occupational health and safety framework （workplace noise-exposure control）
Noise-related test data captured within the SLS/IEC 62841 safety assessment where applicable
General environmental and nuisance noise rules
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 safety evidence usually focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may report declared noise values from the tool standard, but it does not produce an EU-style guaranteed sound-power marking. For Sri Lanka this is acceptable because no such product marking is demanded; the relevant focus is workplace exposure and any declared values, not a marking regime.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series （declared noise values where reported）
China workplace noise-exposure rules where applicable
rows.gap: Honest reading: the EU outdoor-noise gap that appears for the EU lane does not apply here, because Sri Lanka has no equivalent product-marking regime. The residual point is to retain any declared noise values from the tool standard for workplace safety and customer information, and to comply with general occupational and environmental noise rules. There is no SLSI noise-marking step to add.

target.en: No mandatory product-level outdoor-noise marking for the tool in Sri Lanka. Occupational noise-exposure duties under the Department of Labour framework and general environmental noise rules apply to use and workplaces rather than to the product as a market-entry marking.
target.zh: 斯里兰卡对工具不存在强制的产品级户外噪声标识。劳工部框架下的职业噪声暴露义务和一般环境噪声规则适用于使用和工作场所，而非作为产品市场准入标识。
target.zht: 斯里蘭卡對工具不存在強制的產品級戶外噪聲標識。勞工部框架下的職業噪聲暴露義務和一般環境噪聲規則適用於使用和工作場所，而非作為產品市場准入標識。

cn.en: China reports declared noise values via GB/T 3883 testing where applicable; this is informational and not an EU-style marking.
cn.zh: 中国在适用时通过 GB/T 3883 测试报告声明噪声值；这是信息性的，并非欧盟式标识。
cn.zht: 中國在適用時透過 GB/T 3883 測試報告聲明噪聲值；這是資訊性的，並非歐盟式標識。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No EU-style outdoor-noise product marking is required for Sri Lanka, so this is not a market-entry blocker. Retain declared noise values from the tool standard for workplace safety and customer information, and observe occupational and environmental noise rules during use.

rows.target_requirement: Sri Lanka does not enforce an EU RoHS Directive equivalent as a single product-marking regime, but restricted-substance and material-safety expectations can still arise through SLS standards that adopt IEC material and safety requirements, customer or buyer specifications, and general consumer-protection and environmental rules. Where a tool, charger, or accessory is supplied with substance evidence, it should be retained and mapped to the adopted SLS/IEC requirements rather than presented as automatic conformity.
target_standards: SLS standards adopting IEC material and safety requirements
Buyer or customer substance specifications where contractually required
General consumer-protection and environmental rules in Sri Lanka
No standalone EU RoHS Directive equivalent as a product-marking regime
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review. For Sri Lanka there is no single RoHS-style marking to satisfy, so the China material evidence is useful supporting documentation and should be kept consistent with the adopted SLS/IEC requirements and any buyer specification.
rows.gap: Honest reading: there is no mandatory Sri Lanka RoHS marking step to add, so this is not a market-entry blocker by itself. The residual action is to keep substance and material evidence aligned with the adopted SLS/IEC safety requirements and with any buyer or environmental obligation, rather than building an EU-format RoHS declaration that Sri Lanka does not require.

target.en: No standalone mandatory RoHS-style product marking in Sri Lanka. Substance and material expectations apply through adopted SLS/IEC safety requirements, buyer specifications, and general environmental and consumer-protection rules.
target.zh: 斯里兰卡不存在独立的强制 RoHS 式产品标识。物质和材料期望通过采用的 SLS/IEC 安全要求、买方规格及一般环境与消费者保护规则适用。
target.zht: 斯里蘭卡不存在獨立的強制 RoHS 式產品標識。物質和材料期望透過採用的 SLS/IEC 安全要求、買方規格及一般環境與消費者保護規則適用。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 material evidence is supporting documentation; it does not map to a single Sri Lanka RoHS marking because none exists.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料证据是支持文件；它不对应单一的斯里兰卡 RoHS 标识，因为该标识并不存在。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 材料證據是支援文件；它不對應單一的斯里蘭卡 RoHS 標識，因為該標識並不存在。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] No mandatory RoHS-style marking applies in Sri Lanka, so substances are not a standalone market-entry blocker. Keep China material evidence aligned with the adopted SLS/IEC safety requirements and any buyer or environmental obligation.

rows.requirement: Cordless Tools: Battery Safety and TRCSL Radio Approval
rows.target_requirement: Cordless power tools raise two distinct Sri Lanka points. First, the lithium battery pack and charger are assessed for electrical and battery safety against the adopted SLS/IEC standards within the SLSI scheme. Second, any tool with a radio function （for example wireless connectivity in the tool or a smart battery） needs type approval from the Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka （TRCSL） for the radio module. Sri Lanka does not operate an EU Battery Regulation equivalent, so there is no separate battery passport or producer-responsibility marking duty mirroring Regulation （EU） 2023/1542.
target_standards: SLS standards adopting IEC battery and tool safety requirements （battery pack and charger）
TRCSL type approval for the radio module of cordless or connected tools （Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka）
No EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 equivalent in Sri Lanka
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883 or under separate lithium-battery transport and safety evidence. Any wireless function is typically covered by China SRRC type approval for the China domestic market. Neither automatically satisfies SLSI battery-safety acceptance or TRCSL radio type approval in Sri Lanka.
china_standards: GB/T 3883 series （battery pack tested with tool）
China lithium-battery safety and transport evidence where applicable
China SRRC type approval for wireless modules （domestic market）
rows.gap: Honest reading: the heavy EU Battery Regulation gap does not apply, because Sri Lanka has no 2023/1542 equivalent. The real cordless gaps are narrower. The battery pack and charger still need SLSI-accepted battery and electrical safety evidence, and any radio function needs a TRCSL type approval that China SRRC approval does not substitute for. A tool that passes China domestic and transport tests can still be blocked at TRCSL radio approval.

target.en: Mandatory in practice: SLSI-accepted battery and electrical safety evidence for the battery pack and charger, and TRCSL type approval for any radio module in cordless or connected tools. There is no separate EU-style battery economic-operator or battery-passport obligation.
target.zh: 实务上为强制：电池包和充电器须有 SLSI 接受的电池和电气安全证据，无绳或联网工具中的任何无线电模块须有 TRCSL 型号核准。不存在单独的欧盟式电池经济经营者或电池护照义务。
target.zht: 實務上為強制：電池包和充電器須有 SLSI 接受的電池和電氣安全證據，無繩或連網工具中的任何無線電模組須有 TRCSL 型號核准。不存在單獨的歐盟式電池經濟經營者或電池護照義務。

cn.en: China tool and battery evidence and SRRC wireless approval cover the China domestic market and do not automatically satisfy SLSI battery acceptance or TRCSL radio type approval.
cn.zh: 中国工具和电池证据及 SRRC 无线核准覆盖中国国内市场，不会自动满足 SLSI 电池接受或 TRCSL 无线电型号核准。
cn.zht: 中國工具和電池證據及 SRRC 無線核准覆蓋中國國內市場，不會自動滿足 SLSI 電池接受或 TRCSL 無線電型號核准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Sri-Lanka-ready for cordless tools until the battery pack and charger carry SLSI-accepted safety evidence and any radio module holds TRCSL type approval. No EU Battery Regulation equivalent applies, so a battery passport is not required.

source.publisher: Telecommunications Regulatory Commission of Sri Lanka （TRCSL）
